reason: React Router >=7.12.0 <8.3.0 executes an action before returning the 400 in RSC mode, bypassing CSRF protection. This template is a client-rendered Vite SPA using react-router-dom 7.x in declarative/data mode: there is no RSC entry, no createCallServer call, and no @react-router/dev in the tree, so the vulnerable path is not reachable here. A fork that adopts RSC mode must re-evaluate this allowance instead of inheriting it.
upstream: Fixed in react-router 8.3.0, a major-version migration with its own breaking changes, so it is scheduled as its own task rather than folded into a tooling pass. npm's suggested remediation is react-router-dom@7.11.0, a downgrade below the vulnerable floor that also drops two minors of unrelated fixes.
